subject.name: AP U.S. History
subject.cedVersion: AP U.S. History CED (Course Framework V.1, (c)2026; effective Fall 2026)
subject.designNotes: 9 units (Periods 1-9) with official CED topic codes (105 topics), titles, class-period estimates, and suggested skills from the Unit at a Glance tables. MC unit weights come from the CED exam weighting (U1 4-6, U2 6-8, U3-U8 10-17, U9 4-6 percent). Skills are the historical thinking skills 1.A-6.D; Skill 6 (argumentation, 6.A-6.D) is not assessed in the multiple-choice section, and skill/reasoning-process weights are not published. Sub-keywords, kinds, requires and estLessons are original tutoring-sequence proposals in neutral, mainstream wording.
